Capture ownership **before** hide/detach/inertness; BODY afterward does not establish deliberate departure. Growing or oscillating width while suspended must not reopen evidence or change navigation preference. Explicit reopen revalidates identity/access/source generation through existing domain owners. Modal→dock retains valid in-inspector focus/context while releasing trap/inertness/scroll lock; placement adaptation does not return focus to the outside trigger merely because placement changed. Dismissal has its separate conditional return contract.

Another modal or unknown ownership remains existing shared-layer arbitration, with the ambiguous automatic transition held. No second modal, stale callback, hidden focus, surprise opening or indefinitely invalid-width dock is accepted by this response; the unresolved owner branch still needs qualification. Brain Close/Stop, conditional onClose, visible lifecycle, pending request/save outcomes, exact historical Ask and the D06 reader/plot exception remain unchanged. No second inspector, store, event bus, lifecycle or cancellation semantics are introduced.

The response supplies **four exact successor source clarifications** (SYSTEM §6 overlay fallback; EvidenceInspector closure versus adaptation; INTERACTION_STATES recoverable suspension; handshake responsive row) and discriminating facets for **existing N07/N10/N11/G07**. No cases are marked passed. F01 owns composition/reopen/arbitration; F02 anatomy/a11y; D07/D08 and adopting domains identity/trigger/context; D06 its focused reader; Brain/D14 and host their lifecycle/request contracts. Please bind the new candidate's exact delta and affected responses before adoption.
